What this demonstrates

The mechanic, not the footage.

These frames are camera pushes synthesised from stills, so they are soft and they only move in one axis. A generated clip gives real parallax, atmosphere and life — and drops into exactly this pipeline with no code change. The scrub, the pins, the rail and the scroll-driven readout are finished.
